config_fingerprint_method: sha256 of config.model_dump_json(); persistence exposes no public fingerprint helper
label: FICTIONAL SIMULATION BASELINE — NOT CLINICAL DATA
scenario_note: Uses the V0.5 fictional demo scenario assumptions with population_size 30. Not an empirical military population model; not medical ground truth.
unit_mapping: One distinct attended live-fire session day is one occupational event day; one distinct approved product training event day is one occupational event day.

window_semantics.days_since_previous_event: Days since the most recent event day at or before analysis_as_of, capped at 730; 730 when none is recorded.
window_semantics.events_30d: Distinct occupational event days in (analysis_as_of - 30 days, analysis_as_of].
window_semantics.events_365d: Distinct occupational event days in (analysis_as_of - 365 days, analysis_as_of].
window_semantics.events_90d: Distinct occupational event days in (analysis_as_of - 90 days, analysis_as_of].
window_semantics.max_events_14d: For each event day d in the prior 365 days, count distinct event days in (d - 14 days, d] and retain the maximum, or zero if no endpoint exists.
